summaries.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android Smart Flow page class for HP printer details screen automation. Key patterns include: (1) Extensive use of swipe-and-find pattern with configurable max_swipes for scrollable tile elements, (2) Consistent timeout and raise_e parameters across all methods for flexible error handling, (3) String-based locator references passed to self.driver methods, (4) Verification methods using wait_for_object pattern, (5) Text extraction methods for product information retrieval, (6) Fallback gesture click mechanism using coordinates when element lookup fails, (7) Conditional interaction methods with _if_exist suffix for optional UI elements, (8) Navigation flows for printer information, reports, and various printer functions (scan, print, copy, fax), (9) Support for camera scan, shortcuts, printables, and quality tools features, (10) Inherits from SmartFlow base class providing common mobile automation capabilities.
